note: AI-safe placeholder; validate against processed core artifact before implementation. Do not copy raw course text into this context layer.

situation_type.purpose: Classifies the investment situation using the approved taxonomy.

methodology_status.purpose: States whether the output is evaluator-ready, partial, detection-only, out of scope, or needs human review.

evidence_level.purpose: Summarizes the reliability of the evidence supporting the case.

official_source_status.purpose: Tracks whether official evidence is missing, needed, pending review, attached, not applicable, or unknown.

risks.purpose: Lists material research risks without making a recommendation.

missing_information.purpose: Lists information needed before deeper research or publication.

next_steps.purpose: Lists research tasks or verification steps.

human_review_required.purpose: Indicates whether a human must review the output before relying on it.

disclaimer.purpose: Required educational-only disclaimer with no financial advice language.
